invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create, which should never be null under normal configuration.
The config parameter must be valid and is required to build both the meta-client and result.
The context parameter is used to get the storage configuration and is required.
The method's contract guarantees the return value is of type HoodieJavaTable.
It is impossible for the returned HoodieJavaTable to be the same object as the HoodieWriteConfig parameter.
